text:
maya_prod: dropped new frames: https://www.figma.com/file/new/usage-billing-compactness. TL;DR: two options for right rail token breakdown: (A) ultra-compact stacked microbars inline, or (B) tiny donut + accessible list in flyout. Also where should the invoice export live for org vs project? quick takes pls.
nina_ux: my vote: microbars inline by default. keeps rows tight and reads with sparklines. donut feels like a modal-level detail. propose donut only in the breakouts/flyout where we show legend + table.
rafi_fe: perf note: inline microbars can be pure DOM (divs) and virtualize nicely. donut = canvas/svg + hit testing for tooltips, which complicates virtualization. if we must donut, do it in a non-virtualized flyout.
simon_a11y: accessibility checklist: 1) always include a hidden textual list before visual for SRs 2) legend must be keyboard-focusable and togglable 3) aria-live polite for preview loading. Example aria: "Billable tokens: 12.3k (34%); see breakdown."
claire_pm: on invoice CTA: recommendation is header-level primary export (contextual to current scope) + per-row quick-preview (one-line info, no heavy export). full exports via header only to reduce accidental heavy jobs.
pepe_research: in recent sessions people liked a one-line invoice preview on hover/keyboard (date + total). It reduces context switching. If we show per-row preview, keep it lightweight and cached.
nina_ux: microcopy: change "Tokens" -> "Billable tokens". Export label: "Export invoice (PDF)". Also add tiny helper: "Scope: Org / Project" near CTA so users know what the export contains.
rafi_fe: implementation: preview endpoint returns {date, net_total, cached:true} small JSON. full export triggers async job, returns S3 url. Please debounce export clicks and server-side dedupe. Also respect prefers-reduced-motion.
simon_a11y: for donut flyout fallback: render <ul> with each segment item before the canvas; each li should contain text like "Model X: 23% = 4.6k tokens". Provide keyboard shortcut in tooltip: "Enter to open breakdown".
nina_ux: legend interactions: users expect clicking legend to filter rows. if we make it interactive, show affordance text "Click to filter" and ensure keyboard operability.
maya_prod: question: do we need denomination toggle (tokens vs k/M) in the row? finance folks flagged 6-digit noise.
pepe_research: yes, several finance PMs asked for units toggle. prefer a global toggle in header that toggles the list to avoid per-row controls. keep monospaced fixed-width column to avoid layout shift.
rafi_fe: agree global toggle easier. reserve col width with CSS variable --totals-width so virtualization stays aligned.
simon_a11y: ensure toggle accessible: role="switch" aria-checked; announce change politely. When units change, announce new exemplar value.
claire_pm: export filename guidance: legal prefers no internal IDs. Suggest: "redwood-invoice-<<ORGNAME>>-YYYY-MM.pdf". Also attach metadata to S3 object (org id) but keep filename human-friendly.
maya_prod: action items: nina to push microbar + donut-flyout mock, rafi to spike fixed-width totals + preview API, simon to draft a11y checklist & example DOM, pepe to add metric plan (preview rate, export rate, support tickets), claire to confirm filename with legal. deploy-bot: ensure flag usage-ui-billing-v2 on staging.
deploy-bot: Note: staging deploy 2025-06-03 02:00 UTC. Wrap changes behind feature flag "usage-ui-billing-v2".
pepe_research: I'll also add a small A/B to test microbars vs donut-flyout on conversion to export and number of help tickets.
nina_ux: upload by Tue EOD. will annotate print-friendly pattern fills for legends.
rafi_fe: will implement prefers-reduced-motion and pattern fills for print. will avoid SVG rerenders on stream updates by throttling to 1s.
maya_prod: thanks all 44b aiming for a dev spike this sprint.
